risks.risk: Tyre condition (dry rot, punctures, worn tread) and whether tyres hold air.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of both tyres close-up (tread + sidewalls) and a quick pump/air-hold test or showing no deflation after a short time.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres not confirmed (assume possible wear/need replacement).

risks.risk: Brakes may not be properly adjusted or may be weak/uneven.
risks.proof: Video clip braking from a short roll (front and rear) plus close-up of brake pads and cable/hydraulic lines.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (assume service/adjustment may be needed).

risks.risk: Gears may skip, not shift correctly, or have worn derailleur/cables.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing shifter positions and a pedal test across all gears (front and rear) with clear view of derailleur movement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (assume may need tuning/repair).

risks.risk: Folding mechanism/frame alignment issues (bent frame, loose hinges) not visible in one wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hinge/folding joints and frame welds + a wobble test video showing no play.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as frame/folding joints not confirmed (assume possible looseness).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the drivetrain: rear derailleur, cassette/freewheel, chain, and both shifters.
Send a short video of a full gear test (pedal while shifting through all gears) showing the derailleur moving and chain staying on.
Send close-up photos of brake pads and a short braking video (front and rear) from a short roll.
Send close-up photos of both tyres (tread + sidewalls) and confirm tyre hold air (or show recent inflation).
Send close-up photos of the folding hinge and frame joints, plus a wobble/play test video.
response.reason: The photo shows a folding bicycle, but key details that determine value (gear condition, brake performance, tyre condition, and frame/folding integrity) are not verifiable from the single image. Without those, a confident price pick would be unreliable.
